# webtables/program

> Program skeleton: WASI imports, memory, runtime, data, functions and `_start`.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/program.pkg)

Every value is an `i64`. The compiler fills these placeholders:

| placeholder | contents |
|---|---|
| `{main}` | the top-level statements, in `$__pk_entry` |
| `{frame}` | bytes of top-level variables |
| `{functions}` | every `fn` |
| `{support}` | `support` sections of the packages used: the runtime |
| `{data}` | `data` sections: string literals |

`_start` runs the top-level code and passes its result to `proc_exit`,
so a top-level `return` sets the exit code. The memory map and the stack
are on the [truck page](../webtables.md).

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.
